findings.issue: RESOLVED - prior MINOR fr-wavea-1. « le groupe {name} » reuses the noun the same row's count badge already uses (« {n} conversations dans ce groupe »), so one object no longer has two names. Checked for the hazards the round-1 proposal called out: no preposition before the placeholder, so no elision (« le groupe Élodie » / « le groupe d’Artagnan » both read correctly); no agreement to get wrong; masculine « le » is stable. Composed with 11 adversarial display names (vowel-initial, leading apostrophe, embedded guillemets, comma+period, very long, CJK, Arabic, digit-leading, ASCII quote, backslash): no breakage, and the placeholder always substitutes.

PRE-EXISTING, locale-independent, not introduced here. chat-sidebar.tsx:2933 interpolates the resolved label into a CSS attribute selector `[data-disclosure][aria-label="${label}"]` without escaping. The new French template adds no selector-delimiter characters (no ASCII double quote, no backslash, no newline), so it builds the same selector shape as the English one and jsdom parses and MATCHES it for every ordinary name tested, including guillemets and an apostrophe. A DISPLAY NAME containing an ASCII double quote throws "not a valid selector" and one containing a backslash silently matches nothing - in English identically. Reported for the owner to escape at the call site; it is not a translation defect and does not gate this value.
findings.proposed: (owner's call) escape the aria-label value, e.g. CSS.escape-style quoting or a data-attribute lookup by name instead of by label
